acceptance: Red test first: a ref of '--output=/tmp/x' reaches git as a ref, not as an option.
Red test first: a SHA argument 'HEAD;rm' is refused before git runs.
100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: In pkg/acsassert, put --end-of-options before each ref or path argument of a git call, and refuse a SHA argument that is not 7 to 64 hex characters before git runs.
source: operator decision 2026-11-03, docs/plans/architecture-decisions-2026-11.md AD2-0/AD3-4; survivor of acs-predicate-hardening
summary: An ACS predicate passes a ref or a path from cycle data to git through pkg/acsassert. A value that starts with a dash is read as an option, and a value that is not a SHA reaches git unchecked.
title: acsassert passes --end-of-options to git and checks a SHA before it runs git
